豆.reason: The independent character commonly means beans, while its graph depicts a high-footed bowl or vessel. A stemmed bowl is visually recoverable from the form and remains useful in the character's vessel, offering, food, and phonetic descendants.

斗.reason: The simplified character commonly carries fight from 鬥, while the older graph is a handled dipper or grain measure. Ladle is a compact concrete image that explains measuring, pouring, cup, and Big-Dipper associations better than treating every occurrence as a constellation.

豈.reason: This compatibility form of 豈 should inherit the same atomic victory-drum image instead of being decomposed into mountain plus beans.
